normalizedResult: Preserve InnerSignal Private Continuity as a read-only auditor surface while restoring the separate encrypted writer and candidate-audit controller, then privately append the supplied transcript completion, persist the existing failed v1 audit, create repair-cycle-1 candidate v2, and publish an immutable read-only handoff for a fresh independent audit without approving v2.

requiredOutcomes.text: The existing InnerSignal Private Continuity MCP remains read-only and advertises no mutation tool.
Transcript corrections are immutable provenance-bearing amendments over preserved raw turns, never in-place rewrites.
Candidate text, lineage, exact-version audit evidence, producer/auditor context separation, two-repair maximum, repair-induced checks, approval, and sent state are enforced by backend code.
A separate private writer/controller can apply idempotent, schema-validated mutation commands without placing private payloads in arguments, logs, Git, or public receipts.
The supplied private completion, failed v1 audit, and repair-cycle-1 v2 are persisted in the encrypted private store; the original raw turn and v1 bytes remain unchanged.
v2 remains reconstructed_pending_audit and unapproved, and a new immutable handoff makes its exact bytes available through Private Continuity to a fresh independent session.
Public Git contains only generic code, schemas, synthetic tests, architecture documentation, and public-safe opaque identifiers/receipts.
The verified changes are committed and pushed to existing draft PR 49, which remains open, draft, and unmerged.
